build.buildCommand: echo '=== DIAG ==='; node -v; echo NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV; echo 'root @types:'; ls node_modules/@types 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo 'api @types:'; ls apps/api/node_modules/@types 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo 'find node types:'; find . -path ./apps/web -prune -o -name 'index.d.ts' -path '*@types/node*' -print 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo '=== BUILD ==='; npm run build

deploy.startCommand: npm run db:migrate:deploy -w apps/api && npm run start
